# dagsterplus_deployment_settings (Resource)

Manages Dagster+ deployment-level settings as a JSON blob. On destroy, the settings are reset to an empty configuration ({}).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure deployment-level settings for the prod deployment
resource "dagsterplus_deployment_settings" "prod" {
  deployment    = "prod"
  settings_json = jsonencode({
    run_queue = {
      max_concurrent_runs = 10
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment` (String) The name of the deployment to configure. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `settings_json` (String) JSON string of deployment settings configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The deployment name (used as the resource identifier).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import deployment settings using the deployment name as the ID
terraform import dagsterplus_deployment_settings.prod prod
```
